acceptanceCommands: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres@localhost:5432/<throwaway> PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src python -m pytest tests -m 'not live and not demo_contract' -q
doNotInfer: Do not scope the assertions in test_owner_bypass_contrast_direct_shop_id to fix this. An owner-bypass test is about seeing everything RLS would otherwise hide; narrowing its queries weakens the contrast it exists to demonstrate. Change the database it runs against, not what it asserts.

Do not collapse the two isolation reasons back into one name. A module isolated because it asserts on global counts legitimately never downgrades to base, and the earlier 'no dead entries' check would have called it stale.
Do not let _DESTRUCTIVE_MIGRATION_MODULES and _ISOLATED_DATABASE_MODULES diverge. The guard reads one and the fixture reads the other; if they disagree the guard silently checks the wrong set.
Do not treat this as the cause of the failure. It is a pre-existing fragility that #1405 exposed — the same test failed locally before #1405 with different counts (got 3, got 4).
